Name: A Glass of Milk
Author: KarinmedQ
Description:
So, ever been appalled with having to drink milk straight out of a jug? Does it break your immersion that you can't enjoy the freshly baked cookies with a glass of milk?

I was, to the point that I decided to try my hand at modding. This is my very first attempt, and I can't say I fully understand *how* I did it - but it works! Is it balanced? Heck no! 

So! To learn how to pour yourself a glass of milk you'll need to go to the Saloon and buy the recipe from Gus. He also sells glasses of milk if you don't want to "cook" one yourself.

A glass of milk gives a slight speed boost, mostly because I'm not sure how to edit it out.
